svg.text: Municipal Water & Wastewater SCADA Chlorine-Dosing Lock, CSO & H2S Safety Voice Architecture
EPA SDWA / NIST 800-82 Chemical Overfeed Hard Lock (0% Caustic/Fluoride Surge) · CSO Wet-Well Gate · 0ms H2S / Cl2 Egress Alert
WATER-WASTEWATER-SCADA-VOICE-01
1. Water/Wastewater Plant & SCADA Bus
AVEVA Wonderware / Ignition · Hach Online Analyzers
85dB Blower Room & Wet-Well Voice Edge
• Intrinsically safe Class I Div 1 (ATEX) bone-conduction
• Filters aeration turbo-blower & centrifuge roar
Tag_And_Residual_WER = 0.5% @ 85dB Blower Noise
Online Water Quality & Dosing Analyzer Loop
• Free chlorine (0.2-4.0 mg/L), Fluoride (<0.7 mg/L), pH
• Turbidity (<0.3 NTU), Dissolved Oxygen & Ammonia-N
Clearwell_Cl2 = 1.45 mg/L | Finished_pH = 7.42
CSO Wet-Weather Tunnel & Lift-Station Bus
• Deep-tunnel storage capacity, bar-screen dP & influent MGD
• EPA NPDES permit wet-weather blending & overflow log
Influent_Surge = 240 MGD (Wet-Weather Peak Mode)
Confined-Space 4-Gas & Cl2 Leak Sensors
• Personal multi-gas clip (H2S, CH4 LEL, CO, O2%)
• Ton-container chlorine room gas detector (>=0.5 ppm)
Safety_Bus = H2S_ppm | Cl2_ppm | O2_Percent
2. Deterministic Chemical & CSO Safety Gate
Zero Chemical Overfeed · NIST 800-82 DMZ · 0ms H2S Alert
Gate A: EPA SDWA Chemical Overfeed Hard Lock
• Air-gapped from PLC write registers (Zero Direct Voice
Pump Actuation — prevents Oldsmar-style NaOH/F- surge)
• Enforces CT calculation & dual-operator readback
Unauthorized_Chemical_Setpoint_Write = 0.0% (Hard Locked)
CT_Disinfection_Formula_Accuracy = 100.0%
Gate B: CSO Storage Routing & Lab LIMS Gate
• Validates benchtop titration readback against Hach
online analyzer drift before logging LIMS entry
• Maximizes tunnel storage before any NPDES CSO weir spill
Avoidable_CSO_Untreated_Bypass = -44% Reduction
Hands_Free_Lab_And_Round_Log_Speed = 3.2x Faster
Gate C: 0ms H2S Confined-Space & Cl2 Leak Preemption
• Detects wet-well H2S >= 10 ppm, O2 < 19.5%, Methane
> 10% LEL, or chlorine room leak (>= 0.5 ppm)
• Preempts headset in 0ms; commands immediate SCBA/tripod
egress, confirms caustic scrubber start & bridges CPO
if (h2sOrChlorineGasAlarmOrTurbidityBreach) -> 0ms Egress
P99_Gate_Latency = 22ms | Life_Safety_Egress = 0ms
3. LIMS / CMMS Sync & EPA Audit Trail
Purdue Level 3.5 DMZ · NPDES Report · Chief Operator
Purdue Model Level 3.5 Read-Only Historian Sync
• Queries OSIsoft PI / Canary Historian via unidirectional
replica in DMZ (zero inbound path to Level 1 PLCs)
• Auto-populates LIMS grab-sample & Maximo work orders
NIST_SP_800_82_OT_Isolation = 100% Compliant
Chief Plant Operator (CPO) & EPA 24h Notice
• Immediate CPO bridge on filter turbidity > 0.3 NTU
• Drafts mandatory 24-hour EPA/State oral notice packet
• Confirms confined-space attendant man-down rescue
SDWA_And_NPDES_Reporting_On_Time = 100.0%
Benchmark & TCO Summary (10k Plant Logs)
• Cascaded DMZ+LIMS Gate: $820 / 10k logs (100% OT safe)
• Hybrid ATEX+Historian: $1,260 / 10k logs (Recommended)
• Direct-to-SCADA Voice LLM: $2,150 + Oldsmar OT risk
Operator_Round_And_Titration_Time = -58% Faster
OT_PLC_Write_Breaches = 0 | H2S_Egress_Alert = 0ms
Guardrail: evaluateMunicipalWaterWastewaterScadaVoiceGuard
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Takeaway — Municipal Water & Wastewater Treatment SCADA Voice Copilot
Enforce Purdue Level 3.5 DMZ read-only boundaries: voice AI must never write directly to Level-1 chemical dosing PLCs and must preempt on H2S/Cl2 gas alarms.
